svg.title: Lantern Vale — simplified building family
svg.desc: Implemented Canvas artwork for all eleven visually updated building families, with unchanged game trees and workers. Main views use level two except the final town hall. Thumbnails show every structural tier.
svg.text: Actual renderer artwork • broad surfaces • readable props • all structural tiers below each scene
